The main takeaway from our work is that
molecular methods can be used to detect the persistence of introduced bacteria even when conventional plating techniques fail to do so.

the use of selective media for the enumeration of genetically manipulated microorganisms may not be reliable, and that the use of molecular techniques is essential for a correct estimation of the number of bacteria present in the environment.
